parsed.explanation: Trans visibility is legally classified as pornography/non-traditional relations, with production/distribution up to 4 years (13 if children involved) and a 2026 propaganda ban covering gender reassignment. Recent enforcement detained 15+ LGBTQ people in one month, including 8 trans people, with beatings at arrest, coerced hooliganism/pornography charges, and reported physical/psychological abuse in custody. Police collect passport/photo data, do not register or investigate anti-LGBT brutality, prisons leave prisoners unprotected and staff encourage abuse, venues are raided/closed, and state media equates LGBTI identity with paedophilia and foreign threat. No anti-discrimination, hate-crime, refugee or regional-court recourse exists. Foreign visitors face the same machinery and expulsion threats for LGBT organising, with no documented document acceptance to mitigate it.

entry_documents.exposure: Foreign visitors exposed through same machinery; 2004 threats of immediate expulsion for attending LGBT workshops. Police collect passport details and photographs of gay people at cruising areas.
entry_documents.protection: No documented protection for foreign documents or gender-marker mismatch. Not documented.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy or LGBT-organisation attendance can lead to detention, hooliganism/pornography charges, or expulsion.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 15+ detained in September 2024, 8 trans; beatings at arrest, coerced charges, physical/psychological abuse in custody, flight afterwards. Prisons: blackmail, extortion, staff encourage abuse, largely unprotected.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No effective complaint, legal-aid release, or oversight remedy documented. Civil-society reporting only; no official confirmation or data.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest under pretextual charges leads to birth-sex-unspecified but unprotected custody where abuse is encouraged; reporting abuse risks further enforcement.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: LGBT venues closed, raided, intermittently tolerated; capital club closed 2000, 1999 pride raid, unprovoked bar actions. No documented bathroom/ward rule.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Venue attendance increases police contact, data collection, and detention exposure; no facility remedy documented.

care_services.exposure: Qualified psychological help generally unavailable; no transgender-specific facilities documented. Custody abuse reported without care remedy.
care_services.interaction: Emergency or psychological care after detention/assault has no documented trans-competent route.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: 2024 definition of pornography includes trans depictions grouped with paedophilia/necrophilia; 2026 propaganda ban includes gender reassignment; Article 343 prosecution. State TV equates LGBTI with paedophilia and foreign weapon, national-security 'traditional values'.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No anti-discrimination or hate-crime prohibition; persecution on SOGI grounds not recognised.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State threat-framing licenses police enforcement and public hostility; depiction law can attach to a visitor's own image/public presence.

minors_guardians.exposure: Pornography penalties rise to 13 years where children are involved; 2026 law bans propaganda involving minors/childlessness. Travelling with a minor raises escalation risk if depiction/presence is construed under these provisions.
minors_guardians.protection: No documented child-specific protection or family immigration recognition; same-sex partner not recognised.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian/minor presence can be read as child-involved aggravation and propaganda exposure, interacting with detention/expulsion risk.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Police beat LGBTQ people at arrest, do not registerInvestigate brutality or homophobic motives, collect data at cruising areas; victims of rape in 2008 did not report fearing police would not help. Public opinion hostile (84% unacceptable in 2017), open people face harassment/violence.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No hate-crime registration, point of contact, or data since 2015; no regional human-rights court appeal.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Hostile public climate plus police non-protection and active policing means an outed visitor has no recourse and may face perpetrators and police alike.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination, hate-crime, asylum, or regional-court remedy; at least 10 trans people fled in a year; activists report coerced charges going unremedied.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Constitutional equality guarantee documented as not protecting LGBT people in practice.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of remedies converts documented detention, abuse, and violence into unremedied exposure; unknowns on border document acceptance and 2026 law application do not mitigate documented enforcement.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar severe tier: recurring police targeting, imprisonment exposure, custody sexual/physical abuse, courts/police as perpetrators, no recourse. This case lacks a documented explicit presentation offence with routine convictions, but adds pornography classification up to 4 years, beatings, and encouraged prison abuse, keeping it near 0.15 rather than well above it.

More severe than 0.25-A: that anchor has raids and extortion with occasional legal-aid release and normally serving shops. Here state law itself classifies trans depiction as pornography, police beat and coerce charges, prison staff encourage abuse, and no remedy, anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection is documented.

Materially below 0.35-C police extortion stops: this dossier adds a criminal pornography/propaganda regime with multi-year penalties, documented custody abuse, state paedophilia-equating propaganda, and complete absence of recourse, not merely payment to avoid prolonged questioning.

parsed.synthesis: The combined regime is state-directed: national law, prosecution service, police, prisons and state media all frame trans existence as pornographic, propagandistic and threatening. Discovery through documents, venues, cruising-area data collection, or public presence risks detention under pretextual charges, beating, custody abuse, expulsion, and unprotected prison exposure, with no functioning remedy at any level. A travelling minor aggravates the legal exposure under child-involved and propaganda provisions. Unknowns about border document practice and the exact application of the 2026 law do not offset documented, current enforcement and impunity.
